name: opendrsai-windows-desktop
description: OpenDrSai Windows desktop shell and installer host
author: HepAI Team, IHEP <ai@ihep.ac.cn>

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.verify:bundled-backend-source: npm run prepare:backend-source && node scripts/verify-bundled-backend-source.mjs && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-bundled-backend-install.ps1
scripts.build: npm run prepare:backend-source && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:win: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:bootstrapper
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:unpack && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File installer\create-opendrsai-runtime.ps1 -DesktopAppDir release\win-unpacked
scripts.verify:remote-host-final: npm run verify:remote-host && npm run verify:remote-host-evidence
scripts.verify:oaep-release: npm run verify:oaep-runtime-contract && npm run verify:session-conversation-subscription && ..\..\..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe ../../../scripts/verify-oaep-runtime-online.py
scripts.test:voice: npm run test:voice-unit && npm run test:voice-entry && npm run test:voice-ipc && npm run test:voice-provider && npm run test:voice-state && npm run test:voice-speech && npm run test:voice-preferences && npm run test:voice-mode && npm run test:voice-capture-safety && npm run test:voice-capture && npm run test:voice-transcription && npm run test:voice-playback && npm run test:voice-races && npm run test:voice-temp-cleanup && npm run test:voice-validation && npm run test:voice-tts-validation && npm run test:voice-composer && npm run test:voice-message-text && npm run test:voice-stress && npm run verify:voice-feature
scripts.test:voice:streaming: npm run test:voice:streaming-contracts && npm run test:voice:streaming-main && npm run test:voice:streaming-audio && npm run test:voice:streaming-transcript && npm run test:voice:streaming-transport && npm run test:voice:streaming-turn-state && npm run test:voice:streaming-runtime-errors && npm run test:voice:streaming-provider && npm run test:voice:streaming-vad && npm run test:voice:streaming-segmenter && npm run test:voice:streaming-tts-scheduler && npm run test:voice:streaming-playback && npm run test:voice:streaming-tts-runtime && npm run test:voice:streaming-browser-audio && npm run test:voice:streaming-diagnostics && npm run test:voice:streaming-stress
scripts.test:voice:all: npm run test:voice:serial && npm run test:voice:streaming
scripts.verify:voice:streaming-ipc: npm run test:voice:streaming-contracts && npm run test:voice:streaming-main
scripts.smoke:voice-windows-packaged: npm run build:unpack && npm run verify:packaged-voice
scripts.verify:voice-release-ready: npm run test:voice && npm run verify:voice-visual && npm run verify:packaged-voice && node scripts/verify-voice-release-readiness.mjs
scripts.verify:platform-auth: node scripts/verify-agent-square-platform-contract.mjs && node scripts/verify-agent-square-catalog.mjs && node scripts/verify-agent-square-loading.mjs && node scripts/verify-agent-square-ui.mjs && node ../shared/test-kit/run-bundled-test.mjs scripts/verify-opendrsai-identity.mts && node scripts/verify-agent-circuit-breaker.mjs && node scripts/verify-platform-auth.mjs
scripts.verify:remote-agent-contract: node scripts/verify-agent-example-prompts.mjs && node scripts/verify-agent-square-platform-contract.mjs && node scripts/verify-agent-square-catalog.mjs && node scripts/verify-chat-sse-parser.mjs && node scripts/verify-agent-cloud-route-e2e.mjs && node scripts/verify-remote-agent-tool-ui.mjs
scripts.verify:packaged-d1-structured-plans: node scripts/verify-e2e-agent-run.mjs --scenario d1-plan-g2 && node scripts/verify-e2e-agent-run.mjs --scenario d1-plan-g3 && node scripts/verify-e2e-agent-run.mjs --scenario d1-plan-g4
scripts.verify: npm run verify:architecture && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:update-legacy-beta && npm run verify:structured-conversation && npm run verify:structured-gateway && npm run verify:structured-renderer && npm run verify:structured-debug && npm run verify:unified-diagnostics && npm run verify:source-navigation && npm run verify:deep-tracing && npm run verify:root-cause-intelligence && npm run verify:interactive-debugging && npm run verify:python-dap-real && npm run verify:production-diagnostics && npm run verify:structured-quality && npm run verify:structured-integration && npm run verify:structured-visual && npm run verify:structured-release && npm run verify:chat-output && npm run verify:chat-sse && npm run verify:platform-config && npm run verify:oidc-login && npm run verify:platform-auth && npm run verify:workspace-context && npm run verify:workspace-checkpoints && npm run verify:gateway-smoke && npm run verify:startup-performance && npm run verify:ui
